notes: Warm Up 24/7 smarter: knows how many days ago each account logged in on its device and how many minutes it is used per day (all automatic). A fresh / new-device login, a re-login or a comeback after 10+ days only looks around at first (feed, videos, reels, stories) - no friend adds, likes, comments, messages, posts or profile changes - then ramps up over 14 days. Daily time cap per account. Every account is touched whenever the tool runs, even a few hours a day (missed sessions are made up, the tool learns its own online hours, least-touched account goes first). Emulator Mode: fewer, longer sessions = far fewer emulator start/stops. FB Lite task fixes (tabs, sheets, comments, messages, feed recovery).
